name: Stable Video Diffusion
tagline: Stable Video Diffusion is Stability AI's open-source video generation model that converts images into short, consistent video clips. Released as a research model, it became foundational for developers building video tools on top of an openly available architecture. It can generate 2–4 seconds of smooth, realistic video from a single input image and is actively used in open-source video generation pipelines.
